visual_description: I saw three main things, in three separate sections. The first things I started to see were spiderweb-like lines that were not colored, but were moreso lighter/darker over the red/black flickering. The spider-web lines felt almost like a tunnel based on how they were shaped, like it was the inside view of a cylinder made up of the spider-web lines. It also felt like it was moving in a way where the cylindrical structure of the lines were part of the tunnel that was either coming towards or away from what I was seeing. The second part was the most hallucinations I saw in a short period of time. The screen started growing, and it was still just the red/black flash but the screen felt like it was slowly getting bigger, and there were moments were I was fully immersed into the screen like there was nothing else around it, and the screen didn't stop looking like it was growing until that section of my hallucinations ended. The last part, I saw directional lines that were moving towards the curves they were pointing to. The lines were alternating between left to right and right to left from top to bottom. This one is a bit hard to explain with words but I drew this on the paper, as well as the tunnel spider-web thing. It's also notable that I saw cyan occasionally throughout the whole time in small moments.
emotional_experience: Somewhat enjoyable, but easy to stop
consciousness_changes: ["No change, fully alert in the here and now"]
debrief: I think this study tied to how vivid our imagery is as individuals and how that ties into what we see during the flashes.

visual_description: In the beginning of it I felt very aware that there was a screen, but about a minute or two in the screen almost split in two and then looked almost like a black hole in the middle. That went on for a bit and then later in the experiment I experienced almost a hurricane sensation where the entire room felt like it was spinning and the screen was wrapping around my head and spinning the top portion of the room. During this I also experienced seeing stars, maybe they were just white dots but it looked like I was in a whirl of space with stars all around me. The spinning spiral was tilted towards the right corner of the room, and it spun for the majority of the time that I was in the room. Then, it felt like the screen was moving towards me and the "hurricane" spinning was coming closer to my face.
emotional_experience: Somewhat unpleasant, but didn't mind going on

visual_description: Since the very start I saw different visual patterns that changed quickly. I didn't know if those would classify as hallucinations, so in the beginning I didn't press space for at least 30s, maybe more. The patterns I saw changed quickly in the beginning, then more and more I started seeing rotating patterns, like a tornado, with the color extending out of the screen a little bit. When I blinked my eyes, the hallucination usually became less prominent, or even disappeared. I could also stop the hallucination without having to blink, if so I wished.   I got a little anxious, thinking if it could trigger some mental health problem, some thoughts about that run through my mind. At some point while that was happening, I started seeing contours that resembled contours of a face.   Later I saw some more localized patterns. I think that mostly at the right part of the screen and probably more at the bottom.   At some point my eyes seemed to get a little dry, so I blinked a lot. I had no hallucinations for a bit. Then I tried to get back to having hallucinations. I started having a little more again, but less pronounced. Eventually I saw some other colors other than black and red. I think I saw white, yellow and orange, for the whole screen.  At the very end I started feeling relaxed. I even wondered if my eyes were closing a little bit.
